name: EqualWeb PDF Accessibility
description: Scans every PDF on the site against PDF/UA, scores and reports them, and optionally remediates files automatically via the EqualWeb service.
project_description:
Free PDF accessibility checker and one-click AI remediation for Drupal. EqualWeb PDF Accessibility scans every PDF on your site against the PDF/UA standard, gives each file an accessibility score with a detailed, rule-by-rule report, and can automatically remediate inaccessible PDFs — replacing a file in place (with a restorable backup) or saving a new accessible copy alongside it.

 The accessibility check is completely free and needs no account, no API key, and no signup. Install the module and scan — you get scores and full reports for the PDFs already on your site at no cost. Only the optional AI remediation uses EqualWeb credits.

 Live demo: try the EqualWeb PDF plugin demo .

 Accessibility standards 
 Checks and remediation are aligned with the major PDF and web accessibility standards:

 
 PDF/UA — ISO 14289 
 WCAG 2.2 — Level AA 
 Section 508 
 ADA 
 EN 301 549 
 
 Features 
 
 Automatic discovery — finds the PDFs already on your site (managed files); nothing to upload. 
 Free PDF/UA check — an accessibility score plus a detailed, rule-by-rule report for each file. No account, no cost. 
 One-click AI remediation — tag → check → OCR → done. Fixes reading order, heading levels, tables, lists, links and references, and writes real alternate text for images. 
 Scanned documents — OCR turns a scan of a printed page into searchable, accessible, tagged text. 
 Replace or keep — replace the original in place (a restorable backup is kept), or save a new accessible copy. 
 Before/after scores , downloadable reports, and site-wide compliance analytics. 
 Your document is preserved — layout and visual design stay exactly the same; accessibility is applied to the source file. 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Drupal 10 or 11. 
 Free checks: nothing to configure — no account or API key needed. (Keyless checks are rate-limited; add a free EqualWeb API key to remove the limit.) 
 AI remediation: a free EqualWeb account with credits. 
 
 External service & privacy 
 When you check or remediate a PDF, the file and its metadata are sent to the EqualWeb service for processing — nothing is transmitted until you run a check or remediation. Details on the Drupal integration page . By using the service you agree to EqualWeb’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy .
